punchline: Lynch's wife brought home pantyhose, and he bought 48 pairs of the competitor's to check her.
thirty_sec: In the 1970s Peter Lynch's wife Carolyn came home from the supermarket with L'eggs pantyhose and said they were great. He did not just buy the stock. He found that women visited supermarkets weekly but department stores about every six weeks, then bought 48 pairs of a rival brand and had colleagues test them. They were not as good, so he kept Hanes, which became his biggest holding.
